in_marathi.name: Harinath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's delight, Hari's birth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harinath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harinath is a Sanskrit name derived from Hari, a name for Vishnu, the preserver in the Hindu trinity. The name Harinath signifies the delight of Hari or the birth of Hari. In Hindu mythology, Hari is the god of preservation, love, and devotion. Harinath is a name that evokes a sense of spiritual connection and divine joy.
